parties: Kedaara Capital Fund III LLP; Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited
headline: Kedaara Capital Fund III LLP files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Spandana Sphoorty Financial
sum: Kedaara Capital Fund III LLP has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE in connection with a substantial acquisition of shares in Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited. The filing signals a material stake acquisition or takeover-stage transaction requiring public disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure is typically filed upon crossing 25% threshold or prior to open offer announcement; this marks the formal regulatory gate for a change-of-control transaction and triggers mandatory public disclosure and potential open offer obligations.
detail: Kedaara Capital Fund III LLP, an India-focused private equity fund managed by Kedaara Capital, has submitted a mandatory disclosure to the NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations. The filing under Regulation 31(4) indicates a substantial acquisition event-typically triggered when an acquirer moves to or crosses the 25% threshold, or has committed to a change-of-control transaction. Spandana Sphoorty Financial is a listed microfinance institution regulated by the Reserve Bank of India. This disclosure is a prerequisite to any open offer or mandatory takeover announcement and is intended to inform the market and shareholders of a material change in ownership or control structure.
